title: Repeat-Signer Margin - Ostomy Supply Program Convex Barrier Notices
content:
**Compliance note - Ostomy Supply Program.** A repeat share is added to the excess, as a share of it, on a liability notice for convex barriers (A4407) according to the liability notices for the convex barrier the customer signed on the program in the last 24 months (signing date fewer than 24 whole calendar months before today).

| Notices for the convex barrier signed in the last 24 months | Repeat margin |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 10% (the larger repeat margin) |
| Exactly one | 5% (the smaller repeat margin) |
| None | Nothing |

The repeat share is added to the order's excess per 30 days as a share of that excess.

**Cases (hypothetical, excess of 8 per 30 days, 3 blocks, so 24 before any margin).** No earlier notice: 24. One notice signed 20 months ago: 24 multiplied by 1.05 is 25.2, rounded down to 25. Two notices in the last 24 months: 24 multiplied by 1.10 is 26.4, rounded down to 26.
